'''Myuze''' is a NPC from the Grand Quest: The End of An Empire. She is The Fourth Imperial Princess of Bariura Empire.

==History==

Among the Princesses, Myuze is the gentlest. Her specialties are supportive and healing magic. It is implied that Myuze has a frail body. Even so, she wants to help to save the citizens with her magic, even after Sirius orders her to go back to the castle.

Before [[Sirius (character)|Sirius]] departs to [[Vilanciel|another world]], Myuze manages to catch up to halt her older brother. But Sirius assures her that he, along with the Emperor and [[Selvia (character)|Selvia]], will surely come back and rebuild Bariura Empire together. However, Sirius never comes back to fulfill that promise…

===Brave Frontier Heroes===
The fourth princess of the Bariura Empire. Each of the emperor's offspring had strong personalities and convictions, often causing friction, yet Myuze was universally adored. Her non-participation in the throne's succession was partly due to her incurable illness, but it was her serene and gentle demeanor that truly endeared her to all. Unlike her siblings, she seldom engaged in direct combat, yet possessed a rare, innate talent for magic.
==Character==

Myuze is depicted as a gentle young woman, the gentlest among the Princesses. She cares for her siblings and the citizens of Bariura Empire and wants to do her best as a Princess to aid her siblings and the citizens.

==Trivia==
*In the gold achievement's route, Myuze meets her demise by amplifying her power and life energy to purify the monsters in order to keep Sirius safe.
*While not present as a unit in [[Brave Frontier]], Myuze is obtainable as a unit in Brave Frontier II.
**The same applies to [[Selvia (character)|Selvia]] and [[Feleen (character)|Feleen]].
